title: 10 Things a Godly Man Thanks God For That He Never Asked For
caption:
It's Thanksgiving. Most of us will thank God today for the obvious stuff: family, food, a job.

Good. But the man who's walked with God a while learns to thank Him for the things he fought. The door that shut. The breakup. The boss who wouldn't let it slide. The season with no money. The prayer that got a no.

Humility is admitting He saw further than you did.

"My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness." 2 Corinthians 12:9

Before you eat today, thank Him for one thing on this list. Out loud. Save this and send it to someone at your table.
